nav.title: App
nav.description: Boot, and the one container pages mount into.

nav.title: Events
nav.description: on / off / once / clear / emit, a mixin everything else builds on

nav.title: Doc
nav.description: A persistent node: an id, a `data` bag, a parent; any list it gives itself.

nav.title: Layout
nav.description: Thirty arrangements you can browse, each proven at seven widths.

nav.title: List
nav.description: The ordered collection that announces every change — add/remove/move/order by id, never an index.

nav.title: core/new
nav.description: The design proof for what's now core/App, core/Page and core/Router. None of it is imported.

nav.title: Page
nav.description: A node: a url, some content, and children.

nav.title: Plugin
nav.description: A class that takes plugins: Host.use(A, B), each plugin attaches to every new instance, and Host.plugins is a live list you can switch on and off.

nav.title: Property
nav.description: One live value. Two spans bound to it update together; unbinding drops the listener.

nav.title: Role: one Servex role as an object
Router
nav.description: Everything between a url changing and the DOM reflecting it.

nav.title: Search
nav.description: The site's corpus and its one search box — open here, press / anywhere on this page.

nav.title: Section
nav.description: A page inside a page: an empty box that picks an approved layout.

nav.title: Session
nav.description: A record in its own dated folder (YYYY/MM/DD/slug/) with a page.jsonl; AISession extends it.

nav.title: Settings
nav.description: A plain settings store between data and UI: defaults, one instance's own overrides, a change event, a save policy, and a row-per-field view.

nav.title: Shell
nav.description: Five optional regions around a CSS grid — header, left, right, footer, main. Wrap any page in one; put a Shell inside a Shell's main and they nest.

nav.title: Framework
nav.description: A brand over a tree of links, resizable by its own edge. Not owned by any layout — any page can render one.

nav.title: Task
nav.description: A DOM-free unit of work — id, title, a state machine, a computed duration and progress, a List of subtasks.

nav.title: Test
nav.description: Is it passing? The latest run of every node test, failures first.

nav.title: View
nav.description: A chainable wrapper over a DOM element, with capturing.
